limitations: P023 does not identify pivots or waves.
P023 does not determine which internals are required.
P023 does not validate required internals.
VISIBLE means inspection is available only; it does not confirm or validate internals.
NOT_VISIBLE means internals remain unresolved; it does not mean invalid and does not invalidate the candidate.
P023 does not select a fixed finer timeframe.
P023 does not map timeframe to degree.
P023 performs no provider, TradingView, or data-fetching operation.
P023 is not integrated with orchestration.
Exact-value unrelated StrEnum inputs remain accepted because they are str-compatible.
Genuine str subclasses remain accepted according to their exact underlying string value.
The behavior-local and shared INTERNALS_UNRESOLVED enum members serialize individually to the same scalar text.
The complete P023 result remains distinguishable through behavior_id P023_INTERNAL_VISIBILITY_GUARD.
Package and private-module boundaries remain policy- and test-enforced rather than physically isolated.
P023-V1 is a logical development baseline and is not physically protected.

runtime_diagnostic_policy.diagnostic_distinction: Missing, explicit UNKNOWN, and malformed or unsupported input are distinguished by their diagnostic reasons. All return UNRESOLVED_MISSING_INPUT with finer_data_required null and are nonfatal.
runtime_diagnostic_policy.unrelated_str_enum_policy: Exact-value unrelated StrEnum members remain accepted because they are str-compatible.
runtime_diagnostic_policy.str_subclass_policy: Genuine str subclasses remain accepted according to their exact underlying string value.
runtime_diagnostic_policy.custom_equality_policy: Custom equality implementations cannot spoof VISIBLE or NOT_VISIBLE because P023 applies an explicit string-type gate and safe base-string comparison.

status_serialization_limitation.baseline_action: No status redesign or rename is performed in P023-V1.
